title: What Comes Next? Differences
summary: Write the gaps between numbers and see if the gaps follow a rule.

steps.title: How to think about it
sentences: Do not stare at the numbers.
Ask how far it is from each number to the next.
points: Do not stare at the numbers.

steps.title: The method: Find the difference
sentences: Subtract each number from the one after it.
5 minus 2 is 3, 8 minus 5 is 3, 11 minus 8 is 3, 14 minus 11 is 3.
The step is always 3, so the pattern adds 3.
points: Subtract each number from the one after it.

steps.title: The answer
sentences: When the differences are the same, the sequence is called arithmetic.

quiz.why: The step is 5, so 19 plus 5 is 24.
The step is minus 3, so 21 minus 3 is 18.
